patches.heading: Release Version Boundary
patches.body_hash_rule: UTF-8 bytes from the heading start through all content and blank/separator lines before the next heading; heading included.

semantic_fields.predicate: Object identity, immutable release identity, publication coordinates and mutable selectors remain distinct. A version-line selector names the highest-ordinal published immutable RC cut for its project/version line independently of acceptance, and selector movement does not change a consumer's operative basis.
obligations: Object identity, immutable release identity, publication coordinates and mutable selectors remain distinct.
Interpret the mutable version-line selector under Release Method as highest-ordinal published immutable RC, not latest-accepted.
Keep the cut's acceptance separate from publication-selected discovery; moving the selector does not adopt a new consumer basis.
Consumer adoption is the explicit transition owned by the consumer's governing authority under Release Method.

dependency_relations.binding: Release Method owns the immutable cut and highest-published version-line selector identities consumed by this identity boundary.
dependency_relations.required_when: the selected task determines release identities or a version-line selector target

dependency_relations.binding: Release Method owns the distinction between publication discovery, exact consumer basis and explicit consumer adoption.
dependency_relations.required_when: the selected task determines selector meaning or reliance on consumer adoption

argument.conditional_consequence: Object identity, immutable cut identity and discovery selectors denote different subjects. Identity consumes Release Method's publication-selected target and separate adoption relation; cut acceptance cannot substitute for publication when determining the selector, and discovery cannot change the consumer's exact basis.
policy_choices: The highest-ordinal published selector target and explicit consumer-adoption transition are Release Method policies. Identity consumes those owners and introduces no alternative selector policy.
argument.policy_owner_rule: The referenced source argument identifies separately owned choices; a permission, exception or corollary in the local row is not thereby an additional policy choice.

patches.source_pin_action: Refresh the member pin and changed heading/source-clause spans at the integrated freeze. The old declaration block containing latest-accepted is superseded by this owner-corrected meaning; add the final publication/acceptance/adoption paragraph with its actual declaration/obligation roles.
patches.acquisition_binding: The two added Release owner dependencies are genuine conditions for applying this release identity boundary; they are not a consumer inventory. Their required_when values restrict the selected release/selector/adoption task. No family-table consumer fan-out is added.

affected_dependencies.action: Its I4 family row for Release Version Boundary already assigns exact identities and selector/adoption mechanics to Release. Preserve its argument and source_refs-only consumer provenance; refresh the member pin and verify the formerly contradictory consumer at the new source hash.
Its existing consumer/provenance route to the identity boundary retains meaning; no foundation predicate or authority changes. Reuse only with the updated subject binding.
Canonical owner unchanged; consume its pinned exact subject and highest-published selector identity.
Canonical owner unchanged; consume its separation of discovery, exact basis and explicit adoption.

integration_limits: No current account, generated interpretation, frame, compression or Release source is modified.
Preserve the earlier closed source/delivery artifacts and their historical source pins.
Interpretation/source-block integration and independent frozen readback remain with their assigned owners.
